verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Glama serves an llms.txt at https://glama.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that describes the directory. Per the vendor's docs, that llms.txt also advertises an OpenAPI spec "for generating a client", and an RFC 9727 API catalog at /.well-known/api-catalog links the spec and the hosted reference into a machine-discoverable chain. Missing for 10: markdown versions of doc pages (mcp.md returns 404), and independent hands-on corroboration that agents use these docs successfully; one user reports their agent couldn't find a quality-score retest answer in the docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://glama.ai/llms.txt # Glama
advertised from its llms.txt "for generating a client" and discoverable through an RFC 9727 API catalog at /.well-known/api-catalog
completing a fully machine-discoverable chain from the well-known path
